imageDirection.mood: Capable, crisp, and straightforward: crews doing real work and finished jobs that look sharp.
imageDirection.style: Bright daylight, documentary, eye-level or slightly low angle, clean true color, strong contrast, no heavy grading.
subjects: Techs at work: hands, tools, gauges, mowers, wands (faces only with OK)
Finished work: a clean driveway line, a striped lawn, a serviced condenser, a spotless counter
Charcoal uniforms and vans with Volt details (plates hidden)
avoid: Real customers' faces, house numbers, street signs, or license plates
Boats, anchors, ship's wheels, compasses, or any nautical props
Macho or aggressive poses, fire, explosions
Heavy filters, HDR, or neon glow effects
